body_html:
@erinkelly12 @JimKellyInc Two heroes I wish I never had. So thankful for @HuntersHopeFDN for their support of CHOP in the fight against Leukodystrophies. The CHOP family made an impossible but inevitable journey a walk amongst courage, knowledge, hope, tears, goodbyes, and beginnings. Much love to my brother Bobby, hit wife Constanza and of course Baby Bobby, our little warrior.

“I wanted you to see what real courage is, instead of getting the idea that courage is a man with a gun in his hand. It’s when you know you’re licked before you begin but you begin anyway and you see it through no matter what."

Sing a special song tonight mockingbird.
